name: Pine Lake RV Park
note: RV park on US-231 north of Fountain with pull-through full-hookup sites, tent sites and park-model rentals. 2026 daily FHU $49.95 (2 adults + 2 kids), weekly and monthly too; 55+ discount. RV Life 4*/$$ (auto 10/2026). --Claude
inclusion_evidence: pinelakerv.com live with 2026 rates; RV Life 4* $$ over 106 reviews (price passes on the tier, gate 2026-10-01); daily rate published - nightly
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 800 m frame) at 30.5298,-85.3953: gravel loops of RV sites east of US-231; a long pond lies ~200 m SE of the rows behind pines, not at any site - not waterfront

name: North Florida Fair RV Park
note: RV camping on the North Florida Fairgrounds in Tallahassee (441 Paul Russell Rd), ~4 mi from FSU's stadium and 1 mi from FAMU's. 2026 individual campers $35/night, any size RV; busy on game and event weekends. RV Life 4*/$$ (auto 10/2026). --Claude
inclusion_evidence: northfloridafair.com camping page live: 'Individual Campers - current nightly rate is $35.00 per night', any size RV; RV Life 4* $$ over 15, Google 4.1/13; fairgrounds park open to individual campers, not event-only; operator North Florida Fair Association (private nonprofit)
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 1 km frame) at 30.4025,-84.2778: open grass rows on the fairgrounds south of the exhibit barns; a stormwater pond lies across the rail line to the SW, not at the sites - not waterfront

name: Wewa RV Park and Trading Post
note: Small RV park and trading post (store, laundry, Wi-Fi) on FL-71 north of Wewahitchka, near the Dead Lakes and Chipola River. 2026 $30 per night (a $20 self-contained rate is also listed); monthly rate too. RV Life 4*/$$ (auto 10/2026). --Claude
inclusion_evidence: wewarvparkandtradingpost.com live: 'Only $30 Per Night'; RV Life 4* $$, Google 4.3/64; nightly
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 800 m frame) at 30.1462,-85.2117: gravel loop west of FL-71; the Chipola/Dead Lakes cypress swamp lies ~150 m west beyond a tree band, no open water at the sites - not waterfront

name: Pellicer Creek Campground
note: Shaded full-hookup RV campground (30/50 A, water, sewer, cable, Wi-Fi) on US-1 at Pellicer Creek, south of St Augustine near Faver-Dykes State Park. 2026 daily $65 incl. electricity; weekly $425, monthly $975 + electric. RV Life 4.5*/$$ (auto 10/2026). --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Google Sites page live with 2026 rates and phone; RV Life 4.5* $$ over 23 (price passes on the tier, gate 2026-10-01); Google 4.4/98; daily rate published - nightly
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 800 m frame) at 29.6535,-81.2878: sites under dense live-oak canopy beside US-1; Pellicer Creek winds ~100 m west and south behind forest, not visible from any pad - not waterfront (defaults down under canopy)

name: Panhandle RV Resort
note: Gravel-loop RV park on FL-20 at Youngstown, between Panama City and Blountstown. 2026 30-amp $50/night, 50-amp $65 (prices include taxes, fees and utilities); weekly and monthly too. Good Sam listed; Google 4.0/36. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: staypanhandlerv.com live: 30 Amp $50/night incl. all taxes, fees and utilities (passes the published-rate gate for a Good-Sam-only park); Google 4.0 over 36; books via CampLife
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 800 m frame) at 30.4365,-85.3423: compact gravel loops south of FL-20 in cleared pine flatwoods; two small ponds sit off the loop edges, not at the rows - not waterfront
